candidate_relations.reason: Pulsatile arterial bleeding from the ureteral orifice during stent removal, recurrent massive hematuria, and prior pelvic surgery/radiation with chronic ureteral stenting support a ureteroarterial fistula, not radiation-induced hemorrhagic cystitis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Bladder mucosal bleeding rather than an abnormal communication between the ureter and an artery.
